messages.subject: Error in readBin(z$fromjava, raw(), n = sz, endian = "big") : invalid 'n' argument
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to run the RHIPE example in a cluster with hadoop 0.20.
I called R with sudo (that is the only way I could do it) and got the
following error:

> map <- expression({
+ lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){
+ x <- runif(map.values[[r]])
+
rhcollect(map.keys[[r]],c(n=map.values[[r]],mean=mean(x),sd=sd(x)))
+ })
+ })
> z <- rhmr(map, ofolder="/tmp/test", inout=c('lapply','sequence'), N=1
+ ,mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0),jobname='test')
> rhex(z)
